_readme: How the ticket pipeline builds and verifies G-Eskayo/marvin-mobile (lib/project_profile.py; design in CONTEXT.md 'Per-project execution profiles'). Playbook ios-app (config/playbooks/ios-app.md). dispatch is on and it runs on mac-mini-1 only (the Mac that builds iOS and takes simulator screenshots; marvin #613). Check it with: ~/.agents/venv/bin/python ~/.agents/lib/project_profile.py selftest G-Eskayo/marvin-mobile

executor.notes: This is MARVIN Mobile, the iPhone app for MARVIN over Tailscale. Read CLAUDE.md and docs/agents/pr-requirements.md first; the PRD and ADRs live in G-Eskayo/marvin (PRD #152, ADRs 0039-0046). Structure: Packages/MarvinCore is a SwiftPM package holding the logic with its tests; Apps/Marvin is the SwiftUI app (an XcodeGen project generated by scripts/generate-project.sh; the .xcodeproj is not committed). The app mirrors the desktop dashboard's look (Apps/Marvin/Sources/Theme.swift). Put logic in MarvinCore with tests and keep the SwiftUI layer thin. Verify with: swift test --package-path Packages/MarvinCore (DEVELOPER_DIR is already set for you; don't `cd` first). A new screen or state must be reachable in demo mode (-demo, -tab <name>) and get a shot line in scripts/screenshots.sh. Anywhere the app shows a ticket or PR, show its title with the number, never the number alone.

verify.label: Marvin app build (iOS Simulator)
command: D=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/marvin-mobile-derived.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$D"' EXIT; sh scripts/generate-project.sh && xcodebuild -project Apps/Marvin/Marvin.xcodeproj -scheme Marvin -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath "$D" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
